overlaps.locator: Results → Pairwise nucleotide association influences 5′ss strength (P29; Figure 4A–B); STAR Methods → Pairwise dependency (P61)
overlaps.definition_divergence: Both are R² values for models with nucleotide effects, but GraphFLA higher_order_epistasis uses ordinary least-squares polynomial regression on retained graph nodes. The paper fits the matrix model by ridge regression on its selected PSI data, then fits pairwise terms to residuals with the same ridge procedure; it specifies GU-only pairwise modeling. The estimators and fitting sets are not identical.

input.preprocessing: Ran on all finite author PSI values, then on the paper-filtered GU-only subset with PSI ≥20. GraphFLA removed isolated nodes in the filtered subset; see graphfla_value.

overlaps.graphfla_call: RNALandscape().build_from_data(...); higher_order_epistasis(ls, order=1) and higher_order_epistasis(ls, order=2)
overlaps.reason: All variants are reported. On the paper-filtered GU/PSI≥20 data, GraphFLA order-1 values round to the paper’s 35% and 48%, but the underlying fits differ and GraphFLA order-2 gives 73.15% and 64.45% rather than 69% and 63%. The unfiltered and threshold-only variants also differ. This is a useful near-match, not a confirmed reproduction of the paper’s ridge-regression/residual-fit procedure.

blockers.why: The direct PMC supplement URL returned HTTP 404. The pre-existing file named Wong2018_supplementaryFiles.zip is a 296-byte XML error payload rather than a ZIP archive.
blockers.needed_for: Auditing supplementary-only numbers or tables; no plotted values were read.

verdict_reason: The paper provides a directly comparable n_configs target: the IKBKAP PSI≥20 count reproduces exactly, while the BRCA2 and SMN1 thresholded counts lose isolated nodes and the full 32,768 design count is reduced by missing PSI values. The pairwise R² values are a close but definition-divergent higher_order_epistasis comparison. Peak counts and epistasis class fractions are NOT STATED IN PAPER.
